import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Amount distribution by fraud status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='is_fraud', y='amount', ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_xlabel('Is Fraud', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'])

# 2. Transaction type distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(transaction_counts))
ax2.pie(transaction_counts.values, labels=transaction_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Transactions by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_counts = data.groupby('hour_of_day').size()
ax3.bar(hourly_counts.index, hourly_counts.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Volume by Hour', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Amount by transaction type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax4, palette='muted')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
